verdict.rationale: LibreChat's own Agent Builder has searchable Tools and Skills libraries covering built-in capabilities, tools, MCP servers, Actions and Skills. Users can favorite library items and add MCP servers at runtime from a settings panel without editing config or restarting. The evidence does not show these libraries are a real external registry or marketplace of third-party plugins, or that a new capability installs with a single click or command. Missing for 10: evidence of a public/community skills or plugins registry, a documented one-click or one-command install flow, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can browse a real skills/plugins registry and install a capability with one command or click

citations.quote: The Tools and Skills controls open searchable libraries for built-in capabilities, tools, MCP servers, Actions, and Skills.
Each user can save up to 100 tool-library favorites.
Adding and updating servers at runtime from the MCP Settings panel, without editing a config file or restarting
